routes.name: Lao eVisa
routes.summary: Official online tourist visa. You get an approval letter by email, print it, and get the eVisa at one of 9 designated ports. Single entry, 30 days of stay.

other: About 160 nationalities can apply, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia and all EU states. The full list is at laoevisa.gov.la/article/who_can_apply.
Ordinary passports only. Passport must be valid for more than 180 days from arrival.
Tourist visa only. Other visa types are not available on the eVisa portal.
Entering at a non-designated port means a visa on arrival, and the eVisa fee is not refunded.

stay.note: Single entry. Approval letter is valid up to 60 days to enter, and the 30 days start on arrival.

steps: Apply and pay online at laoevisa.gov.la.
Download the approval letter from your email and print it.
Show it with your passport at a designated port and use the eVisa lane.
routes.processing: Usually 3 working days if everything checks out.
documents: 4x6 cm color photo taken within 6 months

fees.label: eVisa fee, US passport (most nationalities, excl. bank charges, non-refundable)
